title: Free Anti-Rabies Vaccination Drive for Pets
content:
The Barangay Health Center, in partnership with the City Veterinary Office, will conduct a free anti-rabies vaccination drive for all pet dogs and cats. Pet owners are encouraged to bring their pets to the Barangay Covered Court. Vaccination cards will be issued on-site.

For more information, please visit or contact the Barangay Hall during office hours.

title: Advisory: Water Interruption Along National Highway
content:
Residents along the National Highway and Purok 1 are advised of a scheduled water service interruption due to pipeline maintenance works. Please store enough water for household use during the affected period.

For more information, please visit or contact the Barangay Hall during office hours.

title: Typhoon Preparedness Bulletin
content:
In view of the approaching low pressure area, all residents especially those in Purok 2 - Riverside are reminded to secure loose materials, prepare emergency go-bags, and monitor official announcements from the MDRRMO.

For more information, please visit or contact the Barangay Hall during office hours.
